{
  "subtype": "exploratory_data_analysis",
  "focus_variable": "regional_cluster",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "industry_sector",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Clean, interpretable categorical variable (industry) that is external to geography and can be cross-tabulated against regional clusters to reveal sector-based clustering patterns. Some categories are thin (n=1) but the top segments are well-populated and meaningful."
    },
    {
      "name": "company_type",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable segmentation (private/public/investor/startup) that could plausibly associate with regional distribution. Heavily skewed toward 'Private Company' (169), which limits contrast, but remaining categories still allow comparison."
    },
    {
      "name": "geo_cluster",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "This IS the regional/geographic grouping and essentially restates the focus variable (regional_cluster). Grouping the focus against itself yields no informative external relationship."
    },
    {
      "name": "tech_focus_level",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Ordinal Low/Medium/High scale that is external to geography, interpretable, and reasonably distributed, enabling comparison of tech intensity across regions. Somewhat derived/opaque in how it is scored but categories are well-separated."
    },
    {
      "name": "description_length",
      "role": "irrelevant",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "A mechanical text-metadata artifact with no substantive associational meaning to regional clustering, and highly near-constant (160/199 'Medium'), so no meaningful comparison can be drawn."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 3,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.55,
  "rationale": "The set contains three genuinely useful associational segmentation variables (industry_sector, company_type, tech_focus_level) that can be cross-tabulated against regional clusters to explore what traits explain clustering. However, geo_cluster restates the focus itself (adding no external relationship), and description_length is a mechanical, near-constant text artifact that realises none of the EDA claim. company_type and tech_focus_level are also somewhat skewed, modestly weakening contrast. Overall the set enables some interpretable relationship discovery but is diluted by one restatement and one irrelevant column."
}
